review_candidates.title: Senior Internal Process Engineer
review_candidates.description: Why this role exists Virtual Worker Now is standing up a Process Excellence function as it transitions from a managed virtual-assistant company into a managed AI-and-human operating company. This role owns the internal half of that function. The mandate: build a measurable view of how VWN actually operates, improve it, and prove the improvement held. You'll own the enterprise process register, run current-state discovery, build baselines, diagnose constraints, design and implement change, and hand improved processes into operational control. This is not a documentation role. Success is measured on verified improvement — not on process maps produced. What you'll do - Own the enterprise process register — taxonomy, criticality ratings, and improvement backlog. - Lead current-state discovery through interviews, workshops, observation, SIPOC, value-stream mapping, and BPMN. - Establish baselines across cycle time, effort, volume, capacity, utilisation, error/rework, SLA attainment, and cost. - Run root-cause and constraint analysis — Pareto, 5 Whys, cause-and-effect, FMEA, time-and-value analysis. - Design future-state processes and implement them in live operations. - Translate process requirements into workflow, automation, and AI-assisted steps with the technology team. - Validate post-change performance and transition processes into control with named owners. - Coach a Junior Process Engineer and set the standard for process work. Your first six months - 30 days — You've mapped the landscape: the enterprise process register exists in first-draft form, top-criticality processes are identified, and you've begun current-state discovery on the two or three that matter most. - 90 days — Baselines are established for your priority processes, root-cause analysis has surfaced the real constraints, and at least one future-state design is approved and moving into implementation. - 180 days — Your first improvements are live, measured, and verified against baseline — with named owners holding each process in control — and the Junior Process Engineer is delivering to the standard you've set. What you need (must-have) - 5+ years in process improvement, operational excellence, continuous improvement, or business process management. - Demonstrated work beyond mapping — measurement, analysis, implementation, and benefits realisation. - Lean and Six Sigma method, root-cause analysis, and KPI design. - Strong Excel and BI capability. - Bachelor's in Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations, or a related quantitative discipline. - Ability to influence operators and leaders without formal authority. - Professional working English. What sets the strongest candidates apart - BPO, staffing, managed-services, or service-operations experience. This is the differentiator we're sourcing for — candidates who have improved service delivery at scale, not just factory or back-office throughput. - SQL or process mining.

review_candidates.title: SVN 19-09/26 Project Engineer Bihac
review_candidates.location: Bihać, Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bosnia and Herzegovina
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Internal and external candidates will be considered for this vacancy. For the purposes of this vacancy, internal candidates are defined as staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded or ungraded contract, including Junior Professional Officers (JPOs), staff on Special Leave Without Pay (SLWOP), UN Volunteers with at least twelve (12) months of continuous service in IOM, and staff members on secondment/loan released by the Organization, unless otherwise specified in their contract. Staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded contract will not retain their contract type if appointed to an ungraded position. Organizational Context and Scope Under the overall supervision of the Humanitarian Assistance Coordinator and direct supervision of the Head of Sub-Office Bihac, the Project Engineer will be responsible and accountable for managing and implementing engineering and construction-related activities, including the preparation of technical designs and documentation, support to procurement and tendering processes, supervision of construction works, quality control, coordination with contractors and suppliers, and ensuring that all project activities are carried out in accordance with applicable technical standards, local regulations, approved project documentation and IOM procedures. Responsibilities Assess site conditions and prepare conceptual analyses and complete technical documentation, including scope of works, bills of quantities, material specifications, and photographic records. Develop all engineering designs in accordance with industry standards, local regulations, and good engineering practice, and consolidate basic and detailed designs into complete bidding and construction packages. Prepare procurement plans, define eligibility and qualification criteria, and contribute to the technical sections of solicitation documents; participate in pre ‑ bid meetings and provide clarifications to bidders. Support bid evaluation, negotiations, and contract finalization by providing technical assessments of offers and recommendations on contractual terms. Monitor construction progress through regular site inspections, ensuring compliance with approved drawings, specifications, material standards, and contractual requirements. Identify risks, delays, or variations and provide technical input for contract amendments or additional works, ensuring alignment with approved budgets and schedules. Ensure adherence to country ‑ specific building codes, permits, and IOM construction and procurement procedures. Perform other related duties as assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education University degree in Civil Engineering or Architecture from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience. Successful completion of the Professional Engineering Exam is a mandatory requirement for this position. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Proven professional experience in project design and in a civil engineering or civil construction related field. Demonstrated knowledge and experience with the planning, organization, monitoring and enforcement of safe work practices and procedures with strong knowledge of BiH regulations within the construction sector. Working knowledge and expereince with project planning and implementation, which would include knowledge of all phases of a construction project. Demonstrated experience in the supervision, construction, rehabilitation, or maintenance of water supply, wastewater, drainage, environmental, utility, or other public infrastructure projects is considered an advantage. Experience in the preparation of tender documentation and ability to participate in and support the tendering and procurement process. Skills Knowledge of construction project planning, implementation and site supervision. Knowledge of procurement and tendering procedures in line with organizational rules. Knowledge of budgeting, cost estimation and preparation of Bills of Quantities (BoQ). Familiarity with water supply, wastewater, drainage, utility, environmental, or municipal infrastructure systems is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; knowledge of AutoCAD or similar engineering software is an asset. Knowledge of contract management and coordination with contractors and suppliers. Knowledge of quality assurance, regulatory compliance and construction standards. Driving license: B category and five years of active driving experience. Languages All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish). For this position, fluency in English and one of the official languages in Bosnia and Herzegovina (Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian) is required (oral and written). Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Notes Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

Ability to manage 2–3 projects per year with team sizes of 2–4, understanding customer needs and optimizing electrical design for time, cost, quality, and customer satisfaction. System-wide understanding, product knowledge, and ability to handle complex systems and ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks with an analytical and strategic approach. Proficiency in spoken and written English is required; Arabic is a plus. Publication date : 2026-06-15

review_candidates.title: IQI - avoin hakemus
review_candidates.description: Voit hakea IQI:lle myös avoimella haulla Oletko työskennellyt ICT alalla vähintään viisi vuotta erilaisten teknologioiden parissa? Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa digitaalista tulevaisuutta asiakkaidemme toimeksiannoissa? Etsimme motivoituneita vahvistuksia työskentelemään kanssamme monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa. Voit liittyä joukkoomme suoraan työntekijäksi tai toimia alihankkijana vuokrayrityksen tai oman yrityksesi kautta. Työskentely voi olla mahdolllista useimmiten hybridinä, Helsingissä, Tampereella, Kotkassa tai Rovaniemellä. Projektien mukaan työ voi tapahtua myös asiakkaan tiloissa tai etänä, mikäli se on mahdollista. Mitä IQI:ssä voisi olla tarjolla Tehdään yhdessä IT:stä sujuvaa ja onnistumisesta helppoa. Strateginen IT Toiminnan vaatimukset ja palvelustrategia Liiketoiminta-, data- ja teknologia-arkkitehtuuri Tiedolla johtaminen ja data governance Tekoäly IT-hankkeiden valmistelu Projekti- ja IT-toiminnan auditointi Merkittävän muutoksen johtaminen Toiminnanohjaus ERP CRM Fina MES Ketterät projektit SAFe PMO Digital Office Regulaatio & Compliance Scrum Tuottava ja turvallinen ohjelmistokehitys Microsoft Salesforce Open Source SAP Vaativat järjestelmäintegraatiot Tuottava DevOps Turvallisuus Platform Engineering Kyberturva Tarjoamme: Tarjoamme ainutlaatuisen tilaisuuden kehittää osaamistasi korkeatasoisissa projekteissa samalla, kun nautit innostavasta työympäristöstä ja kokeneen tiimin tuesta. Pääset osallistumaan monipuolisiin työtehtäviin ja kantamaan vastuuta omasta työstäsi. Työyhteisömme on kokenut ja organisaatioltaan matala, mutta sitäkin hauskempi. Meillä on hyvä työilmapiiri ja paljon pitkäaikaisia työntekijöitä. Töitä teemme yhdessä toimistollamme, asiakkaan tiloissa ja etätyönä. Työntekijäkokemus ja hyvinvointi on meille tärkeää. Tavoitteenamme on ylläpitää vastuullista ja myönteistä yrityskulttuuria, joka tarjoaa oikeudenmukaisen, turvallisen ja innostavan työympäristön jokaiselle tiimin jäsenelle. Työntekijänämme hyödyt myös joustavista työajoista, kilpailukykyisestä palkkauksesta sekä monipuolisista henkilöstöeduista. Jos harkitset alihankkijan roolia kanssamme, voit olla varma, että se ei vaikuta työskentelyolosuhteisiin millään tavoin. Ylläpidämme avointa ja säännöllistä kommunikaatiota alihankkijayhteistyössämme ja työskentelet saumattomasti osana tiimiämme. Tiivis yhteistyö niin pienyritysten kuin yksityisyrittäjienkin kanssa on meille ensiarvoisen tärkeää ja pyrimme luomaan kestäviä ja vahvoja kumppanuuksia. Palkkaus- ja kannustinjärjestelmä ”Meillä tienaa hyvin sekä peruspalkan että kannustinten osalta” Työsuhdeasiat ja -edut ”Kokonaispakettimme on kilpailukykyinen” Tarjoamme: Tilaisuuden kehittyä ja kasvaa ammatillisesti Mahdollisuuden työskennellä parhaiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa Ainutlaatuisen tilaisuuden päästä mukaan IQIn matkalle kohti visiota olla Suomen vetovoimaisin ja luotetuin IT-Kumppani Kiinnostuitko? Hakuaika on avoin. Hakemus kannattaa jättää mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelemme soveltuvia henkilöitä jatkuvasti ja täytämme paikan sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Kerro meille, miksi juuri sinä olisit loistava lisä tiimiimme!

review_candidates.title: Head of Commercial Finance & Business Performance
review_candidates.description: Our client is a major international retail organisation with an established presence across the Middle East. As part of its continued development in Jordan, the business is seeking an accomplished commercial finance leader to join its senior management team. This is a highly influential leadership appointment with responsibility for business planning, commercial performance, financial strategy and operational decision support. Working closely with the General Manager and senior functional leaders, the successful candidate will help shape the direction of the business, challenge commercial assumptions and ensure that strategic decisions are supported by robust financial and operational insight. The Opportunity The Head of Commercial Finance & Business Performance will act as a strategic partner to the leadership team, providing the commercial intelligence required to drive profitable growth, improve operational efficiency and strengthen overall business performance. This is not a traditional financial-control or accounting position. The role requires a commercially astute leader who can look beyond the numbers, understand the operational drivers behind performance and translate complex information into clear business priorities. You will bring together financial planning, commercial analysis and operational performance, helping the organisation make better decisions across sales, profitability, investment, productivity, cost management and long-term growth. Key Responsibilities Act as a trusted strategic and commercial adviser to the General Manager and senior leadership team. Lead the annual business-planning, budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning processes. Translate the organisation’s strategic objectives into measurable financial and operational priorities. Evaluate business performance across sales, margin, profitability, costs, productivity and customer-related measures. Provide forward-looking commercial insight rather than solely reporting historical results. Identify emerging risks, performance gaps and opportunities for profitable growth. Challenge commercial and operational assumptions constructively, ensuring major decisions are supported by reliable analysis. Lead scenario planning, investment appraisals, feasibility assessments and business-case development. Partner with operational leaders to improve performance, resource allocation and commercial accountability. Support strategic decisions relating to pricing, promotions, product performance, cost optimisation and capital investment. Establish and maintain meaningful performance indicators across the organisation. Present clear, concise and commercially relevant recommendations to senior stakeholders. Strengthen financial understanding among non-finance leaders and embed a performance-led culture throughout the business. Ensure effective financial governance, internal controls and risk-management practices. Lead, develop and mentor members of the finance and performance team. The Person We are seeking a credible and commercially sophisticated finance leader with the confidence to operate as part of a senior management team. The successful candidate is likely to offer: Substantial leadership experience within commercial finance, FP&A, business performance or strategic finance. Previous experience operating at Head of Finance, Commercial Finance Director, Senior FP&A Manager or equivalent level. A recognised professional accounting qualification or an advanced degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related discipline. Strong experience gained within retail, consumer goods, hospitality, distribution or another complex customer-focused organisation. Demonstrable ownership of budgeting, forecasting and strategic business-planning processes. A strong understanding of the relationship between commercial activity, operational performance and financial outcomes. Experience advising senior executives and influencing significant business decisions. Advanced financial modelling, scenario-planning and investment-appraisal capability. The ability to challenge senior stakeholders constructively while maintaining strong working relationships. A track record of improving profitability, productivity, cost control or operational performance. Strong people-leadership and team-development capabilities. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Fluency in English, with Arabic highly advantageous. Experience within a multinational, regional group or large-scale retail environment would be particularly valuable.
